clos.original_description: Understand the concepts of Reinforcement Learning
clos.enriched_description: Understand the concepts of Reinforcement Learning. The scope includes Exploration vs. Exploitation Tradeoff, Introduction to Markov Decision Processes, Goal of Reinforcement Learning, and Guided Project: Create a Tic-Tac-Toe game in Python.

clos.original_description: Know how to implement dynamic programming as an efficient solution approach to an industrial control problem
clos.enriched_description: Know how to implement dynamic programming as an efficient solution approach to an industrial control problem. The scope includes Policy Evaluation (Prediction), Policy Iteration (Control), Generalized Policy Iteration, and Guided Project: Create a Tic-Tac-Toe game in Python.

clos.original_description: Understand several algorithms for estimating value: Temporal-Difference learning, Monte Carlo
clos.enriched_description: Understand several algorithms for estimating value: Temporal-Difference learning, Monte Carlo. The scope includes Introduction to Monte-Carlo Methods, Monte-Carlo for Control, Exploration Methods for Monte-Carlo, and Introduction to Temporal Difference Learning.

clos.original_description: Undersatnd and implement a model-based approach to RL: Temporal-Difference, Expected Sarsa, Q-learning
clos.enriched_description: Understand and implement a model-based approach to RL: Temporal-Difference, Expected Sarsa, Q-learning. The scope includes Off-policy Temporal Difference Control: Q-learning and Expected Sarsa.

clos.original_description: Understand several approaches that affect approximate value functions: supervised learning, fixed basis, neural network.
clos.enriched_description: Understand several approaches that affect approximate value functions: supervised learning, fixed basis, neural network. The scope includes Estimating Value Functions as Supervised Learning, The Objective for Temporal Difference, Linear Temporal Difference, Feature Construction for Linear Methods, and Guided Project: Create a Tic-Tac-Toe game in Python.

clos.original_description: Understand how function approximation is used to predict and control in Reinforcement Learning
clos.enriched_description: Understand how function approximation is used to predict and control in Reinforcement Learning. The scope includes Episodic Sarsa with Function Approximation, Exploration under Function Approximation, Understand Average Reward, and Learning Parameterized Policies.

clos.original_description: Understand and implement an RL solution to a problem step by step: problem formulation, appropriate algorithm selection, implementation, and empirical study into the effectiveness of the solution.
clos.enriched_description: Understand and implement an RL solution to a problem step by step: problem formulation, appropriate algorithm selection, implementation, and empirical study into the effectiveness of the solution. The scope includes Assignment guide 1, Assignment guide 2, Assignment- Assignment grading, and Review course.
